title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Metagauss…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Metagauss ProfileGrid plugin versions up to and including 6.0.0.6. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing an attacker to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of the victim's browser. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
